rows.what_the_ink_shows: The disputed letter has a straight centered vertical stem between top and bottom horizontal bars, with both bars extending on either side; it is I. It lacks the right-hand bowed stem and leftward foot of the J in condition b, also cropped for comparison. See crops/150_scan082_L496.jpg and crops/150_scan082_L496_J_compare.jpg.
rows.note: Resolve only the optical uncertainty to the written I. The mathematically intended J remains an author-slip note, as in the supplied row and human comment; it must not replace the plainly barred I.
